enonce.question: Match the question with the answer: Where are you from? (a) I am nine. (b) I am from Tunisia.
Choose: ___! My name is Rim. (Hello / Goodbye)
Choose: How are you? I am ___, thank you. (fine / nine / from)
Fill in: How ___ are you? I am nine. (old / fine / from)
Choose the correct sentence: (a) I have nine years. (b) I am nine years old.
Fill in: I ___ ten years old. (am / have / is)
Put the words in order: name / What's / your / ?
Introduce yourself: write your name, your age and your country.
You meet a new friend. Write the question to ask his age.
Correct the mistake: She am from Tunisia.
Choose: The cat is ___ the table. It is below the table. (under / on / in)
Fill in: There ___ a sofa in the living room. (is / are)
Choose: We cook in the ___. (kitchen / bathroom / garden)
Match: We sleep in the ___. (bedroom / kitchen / garden)
Fill in: There ___ two chairs in the kitchen. (is / are)
Put the words in order: is / a lamp / There / in my room
Choose the correct sentence: (a) There are a bed in my room. (b) There is a bed in my room.
Write two sentences about your room: one with There is, one with There are.
Correct the mistake: My shoes is under the bed.
Where is your school bag now? Write one sentence with in, on or under.
Choose: I do my homework in the ___. (evening / kitchen / apple)
Match: 7:00 = ? (seven o'clock / half past seven)
Fill in: I go to school ___ eight o'clock. (at / on / in)
Choose: I ___ up at seven o'clock. (wake / eat / go)
Match: 7:30 = ? (half past seven / seven o'clock)
Put the words in order: at / get up / I / seven o'clock
Choose the correct sentence: (a) It is half past eight. (b) It is eight half past.
Write two sentences about your morning: two actions with their times.
What time do you go to bed? Write one sentence.
Correct the mistake: I have breakfast on seven o'clock.
Choose: In summer, it is ___ in Tunisia. (hot / cold / snowy)
Fill in: Today ___ Monday. (is / are / am)
Choose the month: June / Monday / sunny.
Choose: When there is rain, the day is ___. (rainy / sunny / windy)
Fill in the question: What's the weather ___? (like / is / day)
Choose the correct sentence: (a) today is friday. (b) Today is Friday.
Put the words in order: is / It / and hot / sunny
Correct the mistake: It is rain today.
Answer in English: How many days are there in a week? How many months in a year?
Write one sentence about the weather today. Start with It is.
Choose: I like ___ football. (playing / play / plays)
Match: We read ___. (books / balls / bikes)
Fill in: Can you swim? Yes, I ___. (can / can't / am)
Choose: She rides a ___. (bike / book / song)
Fill in: He ___ swim, but he can't play tennis. (can / like / is)
Choose the correct sentence: (a) I like swim. (b) I like swimming.
Put the words in order: drawing / loves / Leila / animals
What is your hobby? Write one sentence.
Correct the mistake: She can rides a bike.
Write two sentences: one thing you CAN do and one thing you CAN'T do.
Match the question with the answer: How much is it? (a) It is two dinars. (b) It is a banana.
Choose the fruit: banana / carrot / onion.
Fill in: Can I ___ two apples, please? (have / am / like)
Choose the vegetable: potato / orange / date.
Choose the polite sentence: (a) Give me apples! (b) Can I have some apples, please?
Fill in: How ___ is the watermelon? (much / old / many)
Put the words in order: a kilo of tomatoes / Can I have / please / ?
Write a mini dialogue at the market: the buyer asks for a fruit, the seller answers.
Correct the mistake: I like orange, they are sweet.
Write your shopping list in English: two fruits and one vegetable.
Fill in: The school is ___ to the mosque. (next / near / between)
Match: Sick people go to the ___. (hospital / stadium / café)
Choose: Children play in the ___. (park / hospital / bakery)
Choose: We buy bread at the ___. (bakery / park / hospital)
Choose the correct question: (a) Where is the park? (b) Where the park is?
Put the words in order: a big market / is / There / in my town
Fill in: The shop is ___ the café and the mosque. (between / next / on)
Where is your school? Write one sentence with next to or near.
Write two sentences about your town with There is.
Correct the mistake: The bakery is next the school.
